title: Delete to End of Line (D)
instruction_text:
Delete from cursor to end of line!

'D' = delete from cursor to end of line
'd$' = same thing ($ means end of line)

Your task: Remove unwanted text from end of lines.

Steps:
1. Move cursor to 'R' in 'REMOVE THIS' (first line)
2. Press 'D'
3. Move to second line (press 'j')
4. Move cursor to 'D' in 'DELETE THIS'
5. Press 'D'
6. Save and quit with :wq
setup_file:
Good text REMOVE THIS
Another line DELETE THIS
